_README.description: Model metadata for DeepSeek's first-party API (native provider, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Exposed directly through the native DeepSeek provider (api.deepseek.com, OpenAI-compatible). These models are also reachable via OpenRouter (deepseek/... IDs); with a DeepSeek key set the native provider wins by priority so bare aliases route direct. Scores are pinned to the OpenRouter mirrors.

models.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (2026-09-10) - 763B params with native image understanding, 1M context, AA Intelligence Index 40 (max effort). Supersedes V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp, which DeepSeek retired; deepseek-v4-pro also reroutes here from 2026-09-14 until V4.1 Pro ships. Score at the high-effort anchor is an ESTIMATE: AA lists no row at or below high (max 39); high is estimated at 34.5 (range 30-37) from the median max-to-high gap of other models.

DeepSeek V4 Pro (1M context) - prior flagship MoE reasoning model. DEPRECATED: from 2026-09-14 DeepSeek reroutes this id to V4.1 Flash and bills at the V4.1 Flash price, until V4.1 Pro ships. The bare 'deepseek' alias now points at deepseek-v4.1-flash. Score at the high-effort anchor is an ESTIMATE: AA lists no row at or below high (max 36); high is estimated at 31.5 (range 27-34) from the median max-to-high gap of other models.
DeepSeek V4 Flash (1M context) - fast, low-cost MoE (13B active). RETIRED by DeepSeek; API traffic now reroutes to V4.1 Flash. The bare 'deepseek-flash' alias now points at deepseek-v4.1-flash.
DeepSeek Reasoner = R1 reasoning model. Direct API; score pinned to the OpenRouter deepseek-r1 mirror.
DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (experimental, 2026-08) - V4 Flash 0731 plus image understanding. RETIRED by DeepSeek; API traffic now reroutes to V4.1 Flash, which has native image understanding built in.
